name: Samadhi of Yesaji Kank
description: The samadhi (tomb) of Yesaji Kank, the loyal and brave commander of Raigad Fort under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. Known for his unwavering dedication and defense of Raigad during critical times.
historicalSignificance: Final resting place of Yesaji Kank, a key defender of Raigad Fort and trusted Maratha officer.

landmarks.name: Yesaji Kank Samadhi
landmarks.description: A simple memorial honoring his service and sacrifice.

reviews: A must-visit for those who admire Maratha history.
Inspires respect for the unsung heroes of Swarajya.
